description_en: Compares the configurations of two published playbook versions
description_zh: 用于比较发布的两个版本的剧本配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun sophonsoar compare-playbooks --playbook-uuid f916b93e-e814-459f-9662-xxxxx --old-playbook-release-id 1 --new-playbook-release-id 1 --lang zh --api-version 2022-07-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ComparePlaybooks

parameters.description_en:

> To obtain the UUID of a historical version, call the [DescribePlaybookReleases](~~DescribePlaybookReleases~~) operation. The system automatically generates a UUID for a new version.
